summary: Iter 51 — Batch feature regression: Dark Luxe landing page, product commission (2%), OT (₹50/30-min block), GST 18%, platform digest email, XFF-based lockout, sales chat, core pages. BACKEND: 11/11 pytest PASS (/app/backend/tests/test_iter51_batch_features.py). Verified: (1) _overtime_for math — 22:10 checkout = ₹100 (2 blocks), 21:20 = ₹0, custom rate ₹200/hr @ 22:30 = ₹300. (2) Product commission via direct-import _compute_salary_for_month with tenant context set — product_commission_pct=2.0, product_commission_amount == 2% * product_gross confirmed on real invoice (₹500 × 2 = ₹1000 product line → ₹20 commission line-item). (3) GET /api/settings/tax returns tax_enabled=true, tax_pct=18. Invoice creation applies 18% of (subtotal - discount) as tax. (4) POST /api/super-admin/send-platform-digest returns {sent:1} — one real email sent to HQ_EMAIL=miracurlunisexsaloon@gmail.com. (5) X-Forwarded-For lockout: 5-6 bad attempts from IP-A locks (IP-A:email) → 423; first attempt from IP-B for same email → 401 (proves per-real-IP keying now works — previously (iter50) needed 15 attempts due to pod-IP counter). (6) Sales chat start + one AI reply + delete inquiry OK. (7) /reports/dashboard 200 with today_revenue, /reports/sales has avg_rating, /super-admin/overview 200. FRONTEND (Playwright): landing-page renders on 1920×4000 desktop AND 390×844 mobile with 0px horizontal overflow, 0 broken images. All bento cards (mira-ai, smart-pos, staff-registry, online-booking, 6 small tiles), 2 testimonial cards with portraits, 4 pricing cards (Free trial ₹0, 6-Month ₹12k, Annual ₹20k with 'Best Value' glow badge, Multi-Branch ₹70k), giant footer MIRACURL text, floating 'Ask Mira ✦' widget opens lead form. Admin login → /dashboard renders; /reports shows Avg Rating card + Branch Performance; /settings shows both Tax/GST card (GST enabled, 18%) and Birthday Wishes card. Super admin login → /super-admin overview loads.
